cureEDMD is operating under the fiscal sponsorship of Rare Village Foundation, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, to provide tax deduction benefits to our donors. Your donation is tax-deductible within U.S. law guidelines.

100% of the funds provided to Rare Village on this donation page go directly to cureEDMD. Please email us at info@cureEDMD.org for more information.

Patient and family-led. Scientist-supported.

About cureEDMD

cureEDMD is a patient and family-led, scientist-supported foundation to advance research into evidence-based interventions for Emery-Dreifuss Muscular Dystrophy, a genetic disease marked by life-altering musculoskeletal weakness and contractures and cardiac arrhythmias that can cause sudden death or debilitating strokes.

Our mission is to foster collaboration between patients, families, researchers, and drug developers to enable effective treatments that improve the lifespan and quality of life of affected individuals.

Please help create a better future for those affected by EDMD.

Frequently asked questions

Questions about your donation?

Contact Rare Village ↗
Is my donation secure?+

Yes. Your security and privacy is our highest priority. We use industry-standard SSL technology to keep your information safe and secure.

Do I get a receipt?+

Yes, we’ll send a receipt to the email address you provide when donating. The receipt will include your donation details, such as the date, amount, and any beneficiary information.

Is my donation tax deductible?+

Rare Village Foundation is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization, and your donation is tax deductible within the guidelines of U.S. law. Please keep your receipt as your official record. We'll email it to you upon successful completion of your donation.

How is my personal data handled?+

Your personal data is processed in accordance with our privacy policy and also in accordance with the privacy policy of GoFundMe, our website partner.
